jobs.title: Academic Relationship Manager (ARM) – Counsellor
jobs.address: Desker Co-working Space, 1st Floor, A-90, Sector-2, Noida, Uttar Pradesh – 201301
jobs.description: Guide students and parents through the admissions journey and help them make informed career decisions.
highlights: Counsel students and parents through calls, sessions and program walkthroughs.
Explain programs, university partners, fees, scholarships and career outcomes.
Guide students from inquiry to enrollment and own admissions targets.
requirements: Any graduate with strong communication skills in English and Hindi.
Interest in sales, counselling and talking to students and parents.
Target-driven, eager to learn and comfortable in a fast-paced role.
